## Highlights
•
GPT-4o & LLaMA 3-70b demonstrated comparable diagnostic accuracy in radiology.
•
No significant performance gap was observed between GPT-4o and LLaMA 70-b.
•
LLaMA 3-70b is competitive with GPT-4o, though generalizability is limited.
•
Open-source LLaMA 3-70b offers a cost-effective alternative to proprietary GPT-4o.
